propositions: Read surfaces (show, list, search, ready) that route through ensure_fresh may return empty or truncated stdout on exit 0 under concurrent write bursts because the reconverge lock times out silently
The ed2b property test (bounding _RECONVERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT to 2s) fixes show but does not guarantee read-output integrity for all surfaces sharing the reconverge path

Every zero-exit read invocation must produce parseable JSON output matching its documented shape (dict for show, list/array for list/search/ready); truncated-empty stdout is distinguishable from valid-empty serialization ([], {})
Reads short-circuit throttle checks via /tmp/.ticket-sync-<md5> marker, so the test harness must clear this before each parameterized invocation to exercise the full reconverge path

A generalized, parameterized property test must replace per-surface bespoke copies to prevent silent regressions across list, search, ready, and show under the same burst-of-writes + background-push contention
